methodology.data_source: Official Foxhole War API, with a provenance-tagged one-time FoxholeStats history backfill

history.war_summary: The most volatile fronts are Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, Oarbreaker, and Mooring County, where recent bases have repeatedly changed hands. Clahstra and Stlican show near-parity combat with sustained activity; Oarbreaker has an immediate Fort Fogwood reversal; Mooring remains contested. Onyx and Endless Shore have meaningful but less immediate ownership risk.

The selected fronts are highly active but largely attritional. Oarbreaker is the clearest immediate transition point after Fort Fogwood became neutral, while Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, Onyx, and Endless Shore show repeated rapid reversals. Warden pressure is strongest in Oarbreaker and Stlican Shelf; Colonial pressure remains competitive in Clahstra and Mooring County.

The selected fronts are highly active and fluid. Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, and Onyx show repeated rapid reversals, while casualty ratios indicate a slight Colonial edge in Clahstra, Mooring County, and Stlican Shelf and a slight Warden edge in Endless Shore and Oarbreaker. The highest near-term change risk is concentrated on recently contested bases in Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, and Onyx.

The war is in its late stage (day 84) with no winner yet. The Colonials hold a significant majority of strategic bases, controlling most of the map, while the Wardens maintain a strong presence in a few key regions. Recent activity is concentrated in a central band of regions, with intense back-and-forth fighting in Clahstra, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, Oarbreaker, Onyx, and others. The Colonials appear to be pushing on multiple fronts, but the Wardens are contesting fiercely, leading to frequent base ownership changes. The overall strategic picture is fluid, with the Colonials holding a numerical advantage but the Wardens showing resilience in contested areas.
